items.title: Ida Goodson Interview, 1961-05-06
items.q: Judge Allen is right here. You might not give me the mind not to use that. I sent you to 30 days of being a good girl.

ctx.x: Sweet love... Sweet chariot... Coming by to carry me home... Where a life was over here... What did I see? Coming by to carry me home... Open the pages... Just coming after me... Running by to carry me home... Sweet love... Sweet chariot... I'm going to want to carry me home... Sweet chariot... I'm going to want to carry me home... Sweet chariot... Sweet chariot... I'm going to want to carry me home... Sweet chariot... I'm going to want to carry me home... Good... Real good...
